core_principles.description: Techwear is built in three functional layers: Base (moisture-wicking, against skin), Mid (insulating, thermal regulation), Shell (weather-protective outer layer). Each layer must perform a function, not just look good.
core_principles.why_it_works: Functional layering was developed for outdoor and military performance. Techwear borrows this system and makes it aesthetic — every piece earns its place through utility.
core_principles.when_to_use: All techwear outfits, especially for cold or wet weather.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Summer — single shell or light mid-layer only.
outfit_examples: Moisture-wick base tee + Veilance Mionn insulated jacket (mid) + Acronym J1A-GT shell (outer)
Merino base + fleece mid-layer + waterproof hardshell + technical cargo pants

core_principles.description: Every garment in a techwear outfit should have a functional reason for being worn — pockets, weather resistance, mobility stretch, or modular attachment points.
core_principles.why_it_works: Techwear is a philosophy, not just an aesthetic. Wearing it correctly means every choice has functional reasoning. This gives the style integrity.
core_principles.when_to_use: When selecting techwear pieces — ask 'what does this garment do?'
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Techwear aesthetic applied to non-functional garments loses its meaning.
outfit_examples: Jacket with MOLLE webbing + modular chest rig + cargo pants with zippered thigh pockets
Waterproof shell with sealed seams + articulated knee cargo pants + waterproof trail runners

core_principles.description: Techwear uses technical fabrics: GORE-TEX, Schoeller, Dyneema, nylon ripstop, stretch woven, Pertex. These fabrics should not be mixed with traditional casual fabrics (heavy cotton, denim) in the same outfit.
core_principles.why_it_works: Technical fabrics have a distinctive texture and sheen that reads as cohesive with each other but conflicts with raw denim or heavy cotton.
core_principles.when_to_use: Full techwear outfits — keep fabrics in the technical family.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Mixing techwear shells with raw denim jeans creates a visual and conceptual inconsistency.
outfit_examples: GORE-TEX shell + nylon cargo pants + waterproof technical sneakers
Schoeller stretch jacket + technical joggers + trail runners

core_principles.description: Techwear palettes are: all-black, black + gray, black + olive, black + stone, or coyote brown + black. Avoid bright colors except for intentional safety-orange or hi-vis accents.
core_principles.why_it_works: The dark monochromatic palette references military and field operations. It also creates visual cohesion across disparate technical garments.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Bright consumer colors break the system — they belong in athleisure, not techwear.
outfit_examples: All-black: shell + cargo pants + black technical sneakers
Black shell + stone gray mid-layer + olive cargo pants + black boots

core_principles.description: Techwear silhouettes are articulated (designed for movement — pre-bent elbows, gusseted crotches) and either tapered toward the ankle or modularly adjustable.
core_principles.why_it_works: Articulated design means the garment looks natural when moving, not pulling or restricting. Tapered ankles allow the silhouette to terminate cleanly at technical footwear.
core_principles.when_to_use: When selecting techwear bottoms — always check for ankle taper or adjustment.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Wide-leg or palazzo cuts are not techwear — they lack articulatory design.
outfit_examples: Acronym P10-DS pants (articulated, tapered) + lace-up technical boots
Nike ACG cargo pants + Salomon XT-6 trail runners

core_principles.description: Techwear outfits should carry storage — cargo pockets, chest rigs, hip packs, or modular bags. Storage should be accessible with one hand and not restrict movement.
core_principles.why_it_works: Storage is a functional pillar of techwear. It eliminates the need for a traditional bag and keeps the silhouette lean while maintaining utility.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Excessive storage (too many bags, too many rigs) becomes cluttered. One storage solution per outfit.
outfit_examples: Shell + cargo pants + waist bag = complete storage system
Chest rig over technical jacket + slim cargo pants = top-heavy storage balanced by slim base

core_principles.description: Design the techwear outfit for the actual weather conditions — not for aesthetics alone. Add or remove layers based on temperature and precipitation.
core_principles.why_it_works: Techwear earns its credibility through function. Wearing a full GORE-TEX shell on a dry warm day, or going without weather protection in rain, contradicts the system.
core_principles.when_to_use: When building a techwear outfit — check weather first.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Wearing weather gear in non-weather conditions is allowed aesthetically, but the garment selection should still be purposeful.
outfit_examples: Rain: GORE-TEX shell + sealed seam pants + waterproof boots (full weather system)
Mild: Technical overshirt + stretch cargo pants + trail runners (light system)

core_principles.description: Techwear garments should connect, attach, or layer into each other. Acronym's modular system (jackets that zip onto pants, bags that attach to shells) is the gold standard.
core_principles.why_it_works: Modularity reduces bulk and creates a unified, architecturally coherent silhouette. Each attachment point serves a purpose.
core_principles.when_to_use: When investing in techwear — prioritize modular-compatible pieces from the same system.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Mixing modular systems from different brands often creates incompatible attachment points.
outfit_examples: Acronym jacket (with integrated chest rig) + compatible Acronym pants = modular system
Veilance Annex jacket + removable liner + compatible base = temperature-adaptive modular look

core_principles.description: Techwear footwear is technical: trail runners (Salomon XT-6, Nike ACG), waterproof boots, technical sneakers with chunky lug soles. Clean casual sneakers or leather shoes do not belong.
core_principles.why_it_works: Technical footwear completes the functional logic of techwear — it handles terrain, weather, and movement the way technical clothing does.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Clean white sneakers, leather loafers, or dress boots break the techwear language.
outfit_examples: Full techwear outfit + Salomon XT-6 (trail runner with lug sole)
Urban techwear + Nike ACG Mountain Fly (technical mid boot)

core_principles.description: Zippers, buckles, velcro, and hardware in techwear must be functional — not decorative. Garments with purely decorative hardware that serves no function are not techwear.
core_principles.why_it_works: When every element is functional, the aesthetic cohesion is earned. Decorative hardware that mimics techwear without function is a visual lie.
core_principles.when_to_use: When evaluating or selecting techwear pieces.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Fast-fashion 'techwear aesthetic' pieces that have non-functional zippers and plastic D-rings.
outfit_examples: Acronym jacket — every zipper opens a ventilation, pocket, or modular attachment
Veilance Composite SL jacket — minimal hardware, maximum function

base_layer.purpose: Moisture management — wicks sweat away from skin

shell_layer.purpose: Weather protection — blocks wind, rain, snow

outfit_formulas.formula: GORE-TEX Shell + Merino Base + Technical Cargo Pants + Waterproof Trail Runners
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Full weather-sealed system. Every layer serves a function. Cargo pants provide storage. Trail runners handle wet terrain.

outfit_formulas.formula: Technical Overshirt + Plain Base Tee + Slim Cargo Pants + Salomon XT-6
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Lightweight system for mild weather. Overshirt provides light wind and abrasion protection. XT-6 adds rugged technical sole.

outfit_formulas.formula: Insulated Mid-Layer + Modular Chest Rig + Technical Joggers + Trail Runners
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Mid-layer as outer garment in dry cold. Chest rig replaces bag for clean silhouette. Joggers with technical fabric taper cleanly into trail runners.

outfit_formulas.formula: Waterproof Hardshell + Fleece Mid + Sealed Seam Pants + Lug-Sole Boots
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Maximum weather protection. Every layer is weather-specific. Lug-sole boots provide traction in wet and icy conditions.

outfit_formulas.formula: Technical Jacket (Minimal) + Black Base Tee + Black Cargo Pants + Black Trail Runner
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: All-black monochrome is the definitive techwear aesthetic statement. Minimal jacket is the outer layer. Everything else recedes into a unified dark silhouette.
